'''Ballair''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of unknown [[Ajah]].

==History==
During the [[War of the Hundred Years]], [[Ishara]] of [[Andor]] sent her eldest daughter to study in the [[White Tower]]. For her show of support of the Tower, she was granted Ballair as an [[Aes Sedai advisors|advisor]].

Ballair became the first Aes Sedai adviser since the dismissal by [[Artur Hawkwing]] of all Aes Sedai holding posts across his realm.
